definitions.explanation: The point in the tidal cycle when the sea level is at its highest. The native ({訓読|くんよ}み) reading of {満潮|まんちょう}.

examples.japanese: {満潮|みちしお}の{時|とき}は{波|なみ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The waves are high at high tide.

examples.japanese: {満潮|みちしお}{時|じ}には、この{岩場|いわば}は{海|うみ}に{沈|しず}んでしまう。
examples.english: At high tide, these rocks become submerged in the sea.

notes:
{満潮|みちしお} is the native ({訓読|くんよ}み) reading of {満潮|まんちょう}, both meaning high tide. The native reading is common in everyday and poetic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満潮|みちしお}になる: the tide comes in
- {満潮|みちしお}{時|じ}: at high tide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{潮|しお}: low tide — the opposite, native reading
- {満潮|まんちょう}: high tide — same kanji, Sino-Japanese reading, more technical
